CYBER DAO / GOVERNANCE PROPOSAL
Upgrade DAO Governance Voting System
DAO ID
cyber-governance-dao
Proposal
02 / 05
Purpose
Improve voting transparency, efficiency, and fairness for all DAO members.
Description
This proposal aims to upgrade the governance voting system by improving vote tracking, proposal status
updates, and transaction verification. These changes will support secure and transparent decentralized
decision-making.
Proposed Scope
The planned work includes clearer proposal state tracking, reliable vote receipt references, better error handling,
and improved visibility into finalized results. Existing eligibility and voting rules remain subject to DAO approval.
Expected Deliverables
A tested voting workflow, updated governance interface, and documentation of verification procedures.
Demo document for development and PDF-RAG testing. This is not an approved or funded DAO proposal.
